By

The Oxford Magazine

on

27 August 2026

What’s on in Oxford and across Oxfordshire this September

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 17:45
Instaread

Welcome to The Oxford Magazine’s guide to the best events, exhibitions and things to do in Oxford and across Oxfordshire throughout September.

September marks the return of Oxfordshire’s cultural calendar, with comedy, concerts, exhibitions, festivals, fairs and family entertainment filling the diary after the quieter summer months. We’ve rounded up 60 events taking place throughout September, so you can easily see what’s coming up and plan ahead.

For even more inspiration, explore our What’s on section for a growing range of events across Oxfordshire, as well as selected events further afield. And should the British autumn deliver some sunshine, there are plenty of opportunities to make the most of it with outdoor dining, country-house afternoon tea and experience days out.

Got an event that should be on the list? List your event on The Oxford Magazine and reach our growing audience of people who live, work and play in Oxfordshire.

Festivals & Fairs

St Giles’ Fair 2026

07 & 08 September
St Giles’, Oxford

St Giles’ Fair is one of the most prestigious and long-standing fairs in the country, dating back to 1625 as a parish festival celebrating the feast of St Giles – it is held on the Monday and Tuesday following the first Sunday after St Giles’ Day (01 September). Over the centuries, it has evolved from a toy and children’s fair to a large-scale funfair, drawing huge crowds for two days of traditional rides, games, and festivities each September.
